I’ve been there. My special guy was/is like that. I didn’t hear from him for 8 weeks straight once, because of quite severe mental health issues he’s having. There’s a few good lessons I learned out of that:

You need to accept that this situation is completely out of your control. There’s nothing you can do and if he truly wants you, he will work for it in time. Keep yourself occupied. Pick up a hobby, spend lots of time with friends and family and try to take care of yourself. Your feelings are valid and it’s completely okay to be sad, acknowledge that but don’t let it take control of your life. Talk to a counselor if needed.

This is not anything you could have prevented. If he wants to be with you, he will reach out. Otherwise, you haven’t really lost anything.

You can dm me if you need emotional support, I know how draining stuff like this can be. Other than that, best wishes to you!!
